notes.owner_scope: one operator owns the entire fixed fleet and can leave Gulf-positioned ships idle
notes.fleet_scope: 280 numbered VLCCs; no newbuildings, scrapping, purchases or sales
notes.fleet_calibration: 239 active vessels support the 9.3 mb/d reference trade while 41 vessels provide a normal operating and strategic reserve; 280 is close to the route requirement at the upper end of tested seeded demand
notes.operations_scope: five-turn round voyage with four opening pipeline cohorts and prompt Gulf idle ships
notes.cost_scope: gross freight, commission, bunker, port/other voyage costs, all-fleet OPEX and idle bunker
notes.excluded_scope: depreciation, debt, interest, ship values, taxes and corporate G&A
notes.pricing_scope: monopoly chooses dispatch against an inverse TCE demand curve; inventory shadow cost is a decision penalty, not a booked expense
notes.bunker_scope: marine fuel is a separate proxy linked to the real oil-price index and then nominalized by CPI
